changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS referral_source ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), phone VARCHAR(255), email VARCHAR(255), address VARCHAR(255), owner INT, creator INT NOT NULL, date_created DATETIME NOT NULL, changed_by INT, date_changed DATETIME, voided BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, voided_by INT, date_voided DATETIME, void_reason VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'NULL', uuid CHAR(38) NOT NULL UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY (owner) REFERENCES users(user_id) );
